hero.tagline: Most crash and save bugs are already fixed — update to the latest patch first.
hero.intro: Symptom-by-symptom fixes for crashing, Fatal Error, save bugs, black screen, and stuttering on PC, PS5, and Xbox.

sections.heading: Update First — the Latest Patch Fixes Most Crash & Save Bugs

blocks.text: Before trying anything else: make sure you're on the [June 2026 patch](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2255370/view/673997481174894605). Supermassive Games fixed the most-reported crash and save issues in it, including:

items: The **"Fatal Error" crash** when returning to the Main Menu from exploration areas
**Infinite loading screens** when resuming a save after using Turning Points
**Save corruption** on PS5 (PlayGo install and DualSense Touch Pad triggers)
The infamous **"Missing Legs"** character model bug on console

sections.heading: Fatal Error Crash on PC — Fixed, but Here's What to Do If It Persists

blocks.text: The June 2026 patch fixed the "Fatal Error" crash that occurred when returning to the Main Menu from exploration areas. If you still see Fatal Error crashes:

items: Verify game files on Steam (Library → Directive 8020 → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity)
Update GPU drivers — **NVIDIA** (GeForce Experience) or **AMD** (Adrenalin)
Disable overlay apps: Discord overlay, GeForce Experience overlay, Steam overlay
Set DirectX version to DX11 in Steam launch options: `-dx11`

blocks.text: Two save-related bugs were officially fixed in the June 2026 patch: an **infinite loading screen when resuming a save** after specific interactions and Turning Point rewinds, and **PS5 save corruption** triggered by the PlayGo install feature or by interacting with secrets using the DualSense Touch Pad.
If your save is still acting up:

items: Confirm the latest patch is installed (the fix is patch-side, not save-side)
On PS5: enable **auto-upload to PS Plus cloud** (Settings → Saved Data → Auto-Upload)
Keep at least 2 save slots and rotate between them
For unrecoverable saves, use **Turning Points** via chapter select to jump back without losing all progress
Install or repair **Visual C++ Redistributable** (download from Microsoft)
Temporarily disable antivirus — some AVs flag the game executable as a false positive
Run the game as administrator (right-click → Run as Administrator)
Clear Steam download cache (Steam → Settings → Downloads → Clear Download Cache)
Restart your PC and try launching before opening other applications
Update GPU drivers first — this fixes most black screen cases
Verify game files (see above)
Disable overlays: Discord, GeForce Experience, Steam
Try `-dx11` in Steam launch options

blocks.text: The May 2026 patch optimized ray tracing and path tracing performance. The June 2026 patch also fixed an FPS drop when switching screen aspect ratio with Frame Generation 'On'.

items: Lower **shadow quality** first — this has the biggest performance impact
Disable motion blur in graphics settings
If you use Frame Generation, avoid switching aspect ratio mid-session
Cap framerate to 60fps for stability (in-game or via GPU control panel)
Close background applications (Chrome, Discord, etc.)

blocks.text: The "Missing Legs" / missing body parts bug (caused by PlayGo/FastStart partial installs) is fixed in the June 2026 patch. If you still see it, finish the full install or reinstall the game.

items: Rebuild PS5 database: Boot into **Safe Mode** (hold power button for 7 seconds) → select **Option 5: Rebuild Database**
Check for game update: highlight game tile → Options → Check for Update
Ensure system software is up to date
Try both **Performance mode** (60fps target) and **Quality mode** (4K/30fps) to see which is more stable
Game Pass install issues: fully uninstall the game, clear Xbox cache (hold power button for 10 seconds), and reinstall
Check for game updates in My Games & Apps → Manage → Updates
